text: The study only included office workers under 40. It was a survey of 12,000 people, so it cannot show cause. The drop was about 11 points, and only in people who also cut down on salt. A daily twenty-minute walk lowers blood pressure.
Drinking coffee improves memory. So far this has only been tested in university students. It only showed up after a night without sleep. The improvement was 2 percent on a single word-list test.

The evidence comes from software teams at three start-ups. Productivity was measured by asking people to rate themselves. The gain had disappeared after six months. Working from home raises productivity.
The new bridge has cut commuting times. This holds only for bus passengers. The comparison year was one with major roadworks. The saving averages twenty minutes.
The benefit was found only in children under five. It comes from a single trial paid for by a supplement maker. It was seen only in the winter months. Vitamin D supplements prevent colds.

The reading app helps children learn to read. The children in the study were learning English as a second language. The app was compared with no teaching at all. The gains had faded by the next school year.
This was observed in bumblebees, not honeybees. The study covered one season in two English counties. Colonies produced a quarter fewer queens. The pesticide harms bees.
A four-day week reduces burnout. The trial was run in public-sector offices in Iceland. Pay was kept the same throughout. The number of sick days did not change.
